personality_one_liner: A hyper-efficient, distraction-free command center that prioritizes action and operational clarity for high-volume sales tasks.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, tight horizontal grouping. Use whitespace for hierarchy instead of borders where possible.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass for sticky daily progress header over the scrolling call list.
Use glass on bottom sheet headers.
dont's: No glass on normal list item cards.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: High-density call list with a sticky daily progress tracker to hit the 100 calls/day goal.

states.empty: Empty desk illustration with 'No contacts imported. Let's build your list.' and an 'Import CSV' CTA.
states.error: Error loading list, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header showing daily progress (e.g., '35 / 100 Calls' progress bar). Below it, a virtualized list of customer cards. Each card displays Name, Phone, and a large, distinct 'Dial' button. Swipe-right gesture reveals quick status updates (Interested, Callback, etc.).

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: A dashboard visualizing the day's call metrics and conversion statuses.
screens.layout: Use a card-based layout. Top card is a large circular progress ring for the 100-call goal. Below, a 2-column grid showing counts for 'Interested', 'Not Interested', 'Callback', and 'No Answer'. Use mono font (Space Grotesk) for all metrics.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Log of previous days' performances and historical call logs.
screens.layout: A categorized list grouped by date. Each date acts as a sticky section header. Rows show total calls made that day and a breakdown of outcomes.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app configuration, import lists, and set daily goals.
screens.layout: Standard iOS-style grouped list. Section for 'Data' (Import CSV, Paste text), section for 'Goals' (Edit daily call target), and 'Data Management' (Clear list).

empty_state_desk.alt: Minimal white desk representing an empty or fresh start.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize operational clarity and efficiency. The primary user flow is dialing a number and immediately logging its outcome.
Implement swipe actions on the home list items (react-native-gesture-handler) for rapid status tagging, saving the user from opening a detail view.
Keep the 'Dial' button large (min 44x44pt) and distinct on every list row to prevent mis-taps.
Ensure the daily progress bar at the top of the Home screen is sticky and uses a frosted glass effect (expo-blur) so the list scrolls neatly beneath it.
Use Space Grotesk (Mono variant style) for all numeric metrics to reinforce the command-center feel.
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the Call Status logger that pops up instantly after a call is initiated, avoiding full-screen context switching.
Implement haptic feedback (expo-haptics) on logging a call and reaching the 100-call milestone to provide tactile confirmation.
